title: 距離使景物更迷人
titleEn: Distance Lends Enchantment to the View
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for Distance Lends Enchantment to the View.
imageAltZh: 「距離使景物更迷人」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: Distance can make a place, memory, or situation seem more appealing than close inspection would.
meaning.zh: 離得遠時，景物、回憶或生活可能顯得更美好，因為煩難細節不在眼前。

formulas.formula: distance lends enchantment to the view
formulas.highlight: distance lends enchantment to the view

examples.en: Away from home, Man remembered his old job fondly but forgot the daily overtime—distance lends enchantment to the view.
examples.zh: 在外地的阿文懷念舊工作，卻忘了當時天天加班。
examples.highlight: distance lends enchantment to the view

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “distance lends enchantment to the view” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「distance lends enchantment to the view」的英文句子。

questions.promptZh: 離開舊學校多年後，阿柏只記得友善同學，卻忘了每天很長的車程。
questions.answer: Time had softened Pak’s memory of the long commute—distance lends enchantment to the view.
questions.answerZh: 離開舊學校多年後，阿柏只記得友善同學，卻忘了每天很長的車程。
